No subgoals!<\STATESEP>.<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>requalify_consts
  capRegister
  faultRegister
  nextInstructionRegister<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs configureIdleThread_def:
"configureIdleThread tcb\<equiv> (doE
    Arch.configureIdleThread tcb;
    doKernelOp $ setThreadState IdleThreadState tcb
odE)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs activateInitialThread_def:
"activateInitialThread threadPtr entry infoPtr\<equiv> (do
        asUser threadPtr $ setRegister capRegister $ fromVPtr infoPtr;
        asUser threadPtr $ setNextPC $ fromVPtr entry;
        setupReplyMaster threadPtr;
        setThreadState Running threadPtr;
        setSchedulerAction ResumeCurrentThread;
        idle \<leftarrow> getIdleThread;
        setCurThread idle;
        switchToThread threadPtr
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs activateThread_def:
"activateThread\<equiv> (do
        thread \<leftarrow> getCurThread;
        state \<leftarrow> getThreadState thread;
        (case state of
              Running \<Rightarrow>   return ()
            | Restart \<Rightarrow>   (do
                pc \<leftarrow> asUser thread $ getRestartPC;
                asUser thread $ setNextPC pc;
                setThreadState Running thread
            od)
            | IdleThreadState \<Rightarrow>   (
                Arch.activateIdleThread thread
            )
            | _ \<Rightarrow>   haskell_fail $ [] @ show state
            )
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs isStopped_def:
"isStopped thread\<equiv> (do
        state \<leftarrow> getThreadState thread;
        return $ (case state of
              Inactive \<Rightarrow>   True
            | BlockedOnReceive _ _ \<Rightarrow>   True
            | BlockedOnSend _ _ _ _ _ \<Rightarrow>   True
            | BlockedOnNotification _ \<Rightarrow>   True
            | BlockedOnReply \<Rightarrow>   True
            | _ \<Rightarrow>   False
            )
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs isRunnable_def:
"isRunnable thread\<equiv> (do
        state \<leftarrow> getThreadState thread;
        return $ (case state of
              Running \<Rightarrow>   True
            | Restart \<Rightarrow>   True
            | _ \<Rightarrow>   False
            )
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs updateRestartPC_def:
"updateRestartPC tcb \<equiv>
    asUser tcb (getRegister nextInstructionRegister
                >>= setRegister faultRegister)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs suspend_def:
"suspend target\<equiv> (do
    cancelIPC target;
    state \<leftarrow> getThreadState target;
    if state = Running then updateRestartPC target else return ();
    setThreadState Inactive target;
    tcbSchedDequeue target
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs restart_def:
"restart target\<equiv> (do
    blocked \<leftarrow> isStopped target;
    when blocked $ (do
        cancelIPC target;
        setupReplyMaster target;
        setThreadState Restart target;
        tcbSchedEnqueue target;
        possibleSwitchTo target
    od)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs doFaultTransfer_def:
"doFaultTransfer badge sender receiver receiverIPCBuffer\<equiv> (do
        fault \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbFault sender;
        f \<leftarrow> (case fault of
              Some f \<Rightarrow>   return f
            | None \<Rightarrow>   haskell_fail []
            );
        (faultLabel, faultMsg) \<leftarrow> makeFaultMessage f sender;
        sent \<leftarrow> setMRs receiver receiverIPCBuffer faultMsg;
        msgInfo \<leftarrow> return ( MI_ \<lparr>
             msgLength= sent,
             msgExtraCaps= 0,
             msgCapsUnwrapped= 0,
             msgLabel= faultLabel \<rparr>);
        setMessageInfo receiver msgInfo;
        asUser receiver $ setRegister badgeRegister badge
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs scheduleChooseNewThread_def:
"scheduleChooseNewThread\<equiv> (do
    domainTime \<leftarrow> getDomainTime;
    when (domainTime = 0) $ nextDomain;
    chooseThread;
    setSchedulerAction ResumeCurrentThread
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs scheduleSwitchThreadFastfail_def:
"scheduleSwitchThreadFastfail curThread idleThread curPrio targetPrio \<equiv>
    if curThread \<noteq> idleThread
    then return (targetPrio < curPrio)
    else return True"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs schedule_def:
"schedule\<equiv> (do
        curThread \<leftarrow> getCurThread;
        action \<leftarrow> getSchedulerAction;
        (case action of
              ResumeCurrentThread \<Rightarrow>   return ()
            | SwitchToThread candidate \<Rightarrow>   (do
                wasRunnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable curThread;
                when wasRunnable (tcbSchedEnqueue curThread);
                idleThread \<leftarrow> getIdleThread;
                targetPrio \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbPriority candidate;
                curPrio \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbPriority curThread;
                fastfail \<leftarrow> scheduleSwitchThreadFastfail curThread idleThread curPrio targetPrio;
                curDom \<leftarrow> curDomain;
                highest \<leftarrow> isHighestPrio curDom targetPrio;
                if (fastfail \<and> Not highest)
                    then (do
                        tcbSchedEnqueue candidate;
                        setSchedulerAction ChooseNewThread;
                        scheduleChooseNewThread
                    od)
                    else if wasRunnable \<and> curPrio = targetPrio
                            then (do
                                tcbSchedAppend candidate;
                                setSchedulerAction ChooseNewThread;
                                scheduleChooseNewThread
                            od)
                            else (do
                                switchToThread candidate;
                                setSchedulerAction ResumeCurrentThread
                            od)
            od)
            | ChooseNewThread \<Rightarrow>   (do
                curRunnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable curThread;
                when curRunnable $ tcbSchedEnqueue curThread;
                scheduleChooseNewThread
            od)
            )
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs countLeadingZeros_def:
"countLeadingZeros w \<equiv>
    length \<circ> takeWhile Not \<circ> reverse \<circ> map (testBit w) $ [0  .e.  finiteBitSize w - 1]"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs wordLog2_def:
"wordLog2 w \<equiv> finiteBitSize w - 1 - countLeadingZeros w"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs invertL1Index_def:
"invertL1Index i \<equiv> l2BitmapSize - 1 - i"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs getHighestPrio_def:
"getHighestPrio d\<equiv> (do
    l1 \<leftarrow> getReadyQueuesL1Bitmap d;
    l1index \<leftarrow> return ( wordLog2 l1);
    l1indexInverted \<leftarrow> return ( invertL1Index l1index);
    l2 \<leftarrow> getReadyQueuesL2Bitmap d l1indexInverted;
    l2index \<leftarrow> return ( wordLog2 l2);
    return $ l1IndexToPrio l1index || fromIntegral l2index
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs isHighestPrio_def:
"isHighestPrio d p\<equiv> (do
    l1 \<leftarrow> getReadyQueuesL1Bitmap d;
    if l1 = 0
        then return True
        else (do
            hprio \<leftarrow> getHighestPrio d;
            return (p \<ge> hprio)
        od)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs chooseThread_def:
"chooseThread\<equiv> (do
    stateAssert ksReadyQueues_asrt [];
    stateAssert ready_qs_runnable [];
    curdom \<leftarrow> if numDomains > 1 then curDomain else return 0;
    l1 \<leftarrow> getReadyQueuesL1Bitmap curdom;
    if l1 \<noteq> 0
        then (do
            prio \<leftarrow> getHighestPrio curdom;
            queue \<leftarrow> getQueue curdom prio;
            thread \<leftarrow> return ( fromJust $ tcbQueueHead queue);
            runnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable thread;
            haskell_assert runnable [];
            switchToThread thread
        od)
        else
            switchToIdleThread
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs switchToThread_def:
"switchToThread thread\<equiv> (do
        runnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable thread;
        haskell_assert runnable [];
        stateAssert ksReadyQueues_asrt [];
        stateAssert ready_qs_runnable [];
        Arch.switchToThread thread;
        tcbSchedDequeue thread;
        setCurThread thread
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs switchToIdleThread_def:
"switchToIdleThread\<equiv> (do
        stateAssert ready_qs_runnable [];
        thread \<leftarrow> getIdleThread;
        Arch.switchToIdleThread;
        setCurThread thread
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs setDomain_def:
"setDomain tptr newdom\<equiv> (do
        curThread \<leftarrow> getCurThread;
        tcbSchedDequeue tptr;
        threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbDomain := newdom \<rparr>) tptr;
        runnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable tptr;
        when runnable $ tcbSchedEnqueue tptr;
        when (tptr = curThread) $ rescheduleRequired
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs setMCPriority_def:
"setMCPriority tptr prio\<equiv> (
        threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbMCP := prio \<rparr>) tptr
)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs setPriority_def:
"setPriority tptr prio\<equiv> (do
        tcbSchedDequeue tptr;
        threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbPriority := prio \<rparr>) tptr;
        runnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable tptr;
        when runnable $ (do
            curThread \<leftarrow> getCurThread;
            if (tptr = curThread)
              then rescheduleRequired
              else possibleSwitchTo tptr
        od)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs possibleSwitchTo_def:
"possibleSwitchTo target\<equiv> (do
    curDom \<leftarrow> curDomain;
    targetDom \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbDomain target;
    action \<leftarrow> getSchedulerAction;
    if (targetDom \<noteq> curDom)
        then tcbSchedEnqueue target
        else if (action \<noteq> ResumeCurrentThread)
                then (do
                    rescheduleRequired;
                    tcbSchedEnqueue target
                od)
             else setSchedulerAction $ SwitchToThread target
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs rescheduleRequired_def:
"rescheduleRequired\<equiv> (do
    action \<leftarrow> getSchedulerAction;
    (case action of
          SwitchToThread target \<Rightarrow>   (
            tcbSchedEnqueue target
          )
        | _ \<Rightarrow>   return ()
        );
    setSchedulerAction ChooseNewThread
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs getThreadState_def:
"getThreadState \<equiv> threadGet tcbState"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs setThreadState_def:
"setThreadState st tptr\<equiv> (do
        threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbState := st \<rparr>) tptr;
        runnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable tptr;
        curThread \<leftarrow> getCurThread;
        action \<leftarrow> getSchedulerAction;
        when (Not runnable \<and> curThread = tptr \<and> action = ResumeCurrentThread) $
            rescheduleRequired
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs getBoundNotification_def:
"getBoundNotification \<equiv> threadGet tcbBoundNotification"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs setBoundNotification_def:
"setBoundNotification ntfnPtr tptr\<equiv> threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbBoundNotification := ntfnPtr \<rparr>) tptr"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs prioToL1Index_def:
"prioToL1Index prio \<equiv> fromIntegral $ prio `~shiftR~` wordRadix"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs l1IndexToPrio_def:
"l1IndexToPrio i\<equiv> (fromIntegral i) `~shiftL~` wordRadix"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs getReadyQueuesL1Bitmap_def:
"getReadyQueuesL1Bitmap tdom\<equiv> gets (\<lambda> ks. ksReadyQueuesL1Bitmap ks tdom)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs modifyReadyQueuesL1Bitmap_def:
"modifyReadyQueuesL1Bitmap tdom f\<equiv> (do
    l1 \<leftarrow> getReadyQueuesL1Bitmap tdom;
    modify (\<lambda> ks. ks \<lparr> ksReadyQueuesL1Bitmap :=
                            ksReadyQueuesL1Bitmap ks  aLU  [(tdom, f l1)]\<rparr>)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs getReadyQueuesL2Bitmap_def:
"getReadyQueuesL2Bitmap tdom i\<equiv> gets (\<lambda> ks. ksReadyQueuesL2Bitmap ks (tdom, i))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs modifyReadyQueuesL2Bitmap_def:
"modifyReadyQueuesL2Bitmap tdom i f\<equiv> (do
    l2 \<leftarrow> getReadyQueuesL2Bitmap tdom i;
    modify (\<lambda> ks. ks \<lparr> ksReadyQueuesL2Bitmap :=
                            ksReadyQueuesL2Bitmap ks  aLU  [((tdom, i), f l2)]\<rparr>)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs addToBitmap_def:
"addToBitmap tdom prio\<equiv> (do
    l1index \<leftarrow> return ( prioToL1Index prio);
    l1indexInverted \<leftarrow> return ( invertL1Index l1index);
    l2bit \<leftarrow> return ( fromIntegral ((fromIntegral prio && mask wordRadix)::machine_word));
    modifyReadyQueuesL1Bitmap tdom (\<lambda> w. w || bit l1index);
    modifyReadyQueuesL2Bitmap tdom l1indexInverted
        (\<lambda> w. w || bit l2bit)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs removeFromBitmap_def:
"removeFromBitmap tdom prio\<equiv> (do
    l1index \<leftarrow> return ( prioToL1Index prio);
    l1indexInverted \<leftarrow> return ( invertL1Index l1index);
    l2bit \<leftarrow> return ( fromIntegral((fromIntegral prio && mask wordRadix)::machine_word));
    modifyReadyQueuesL2Bitmap tdom l1indexInverted $
        (\<lambda> w. w && (complement $ bit l2bit));
    l2 \<leftarrow> getReadyQueuesL2Bitmap tdom l1indexInverted;
    when (l2 = 0) $
        modifyReadyQueuesL1Bitmap tdom $
            (\<lambda> w. w && (complement $ bit l1index))
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs tcbQueueEmpty_def:
"tcbQueueEmpty queue \<equiv> tcbQueueHead queue = Nothing"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs tcbQueuePrepend_def:
"tcbQueuePrepend queue tcbPtr\<equiv> (do
    q \<leftarrow> if tcbQueueEmpty queue
             then return $ queue \<lparr> tcbQueueEnd := Just tcbPtr \<rparr>
             else (do
                 threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedNext := tcbQueueHead queue \<rparr>) tcbPtr;
                 threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedPrev := Just tcbPtr \<rparr>) (fromJust $ tcbQueueHead queue);
                 return $ queue
             od);
    return $ q \<lparr> tcbQueueHead := Just tcbPtr\<rparr>
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs tcbQueueAppend_def:
"tcbQueueAppend queue tcbPtr\<equiv> (do
    q \<leftarrow> if tcbQueueEmpty queue
             then return $ queue \<lparr> tcbQueueHead := Just tcbPtr \<rparr>
             else (do
                 threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedPrev := tcbQueueEnd queue \<rparr>) tcbPtr;
                 threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedNext := Just tcbPtr \<rparr>) (fromJust $ tcbQueueEnd queue);
                 return $ queue
             od);
    return $ q \<lparr> tcbQueueEnd := Just tcbPtr\<rparr>
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs tcbQueueInsert_def:
"tcbQueueInsert tcbPtr afterPtr\<equiv> (do
   tcb \<leftarrow> getObject afterPtr;
   beforePtrOpt \<leftarrow> return $ tcbSchedPrev tcb;
   haskell_assert (beforePtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
   beforePtr \<leftarrow> return $ fromJust beforePtrOpt;
   haskell_assert (beforePtr \<noteq> afterPtr) [];
   threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedPrev := Just beforePtr \<rparr>) tcbPtr;
   threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedNext := Just afterPtr\<rparr>) tcbPtr;
   threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedPrev := Just tcbPtr \<rparr>) afterPtr;
   threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedNext := Just tcbPtr \<rparr>) beforePtr
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs tcbQueueRemove_def:
"tcbQueueRemove queue tcbPtr\<equiv> (do
    tcb \<leftarrow> getObject tcbPtr;
    beforePtrOpt \<leftarrow> return $ tcbSchedPrev tcb;
    afterPtrOpt \<leftarrow> return $ tcbSchedNext tcb;
    if tcbQueueHead queue = Just tcbPtr \<and> tcbQueueEnd queue = Just tcbPtr
        then return $ TcbQueue_ \<lparr> tcbQueueHead= Nothing, tcbQueueEnd= Nothing \<rparr>
        else
            if tcbQueueHead queue = Just tcbPtr
                then (do
                    haskell_assert (afterPtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
                    threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedPrev := Nothing \<rparr>) (fromJust $ afterPtrOpt);
                    threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedNext := Nothing \<rparr>) tcbPtr;
                    return $ queue \<lparr> tcbQueueHead := afterPtrOpt \<rparr>
                od)
                else
                    if tcbQueueEnd queue = Just tcbPtr
                        then (do
                            haskell_assert (beforePtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
                            threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedNext := Nothing \<rparr>) (fromJust $ beforePtrOpt);
                            threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedPrev := Nothing \<rparr>) tcbPtr;
                            return $ queue \<lparr> tcbQueueEnd := beforePtrOpt \<rparr>
                        od)
                        else (do
                            haskell_assert (afterPtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
                            haskell_assert (beforePtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
                            threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedNext := afterPtrOpt \<rparr>) (fromJust $ beforePtrOpt);
                            threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedPrev := beforePtrOpt \<rparr>) (fromJust $ afterPtrOpt);
                            threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedPrev := Nothing \<rparr>) tcbPtr;
                            threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbSchedNext := Nothing \<rparr>) tcbPtr;
                            return queue
                        od)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs tcbSchedEnqueue_def:
"tcbSchedEnqueue thread\<equiv> (do
    stateAssert ksReadyQueues_asrt [];
    runnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable thread;
    haskell_assert runnable [];
    queued \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbQueued thread;
    unless queued $ (do
        tdom \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbDomain thread;
        prio \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbPriority thread;
        queue \<leftarrow> getQueue tdom prio;
        when (tcbQueueEmpty queue) $ addToBitmap tdom prio;
        queue' \<leftarrow> tcbQueuePrepend queue thread;
        setQueue tdom prio queue';
        threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbQueued := True \<rparr>) thread
    od)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs tcbSchedAppend_def:
"tcbSchedAppend thread\<equiv> (do
    stateAssert ksReadyQueues_asrt [];
    runnable \<leftarrow> isRunnable thread;
    haskell_assert runnable [];
    queued \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbQueued thread;
    unless queued $ (do
        tdom \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbDomain thread;
        prio \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbPriority thread;
        queue \<leftarrow> getQueue tdom prio;
        when (tcbQueueEmpty queue) $ addToBitmap tdom prio;
        queue' \<leftarrow> tcbQueueAppend queue thread;
        setQueue tdom prio queue';
        threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbQueued := True \<rparr>) thread
    od)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs tcbSchedDequeue_def:
"tcbSchedDequeue thread\<equiv> (do
    stateAssert ksReadyQueues_asrt [];
    queued \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbQueued thread;
    when queued $ (do
        tdom \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbDomain thread;
        prio \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbPriority thread;
        queue \<leftarrow> getQueue tdom prio;
        queue' \<leftarrow> tcbQueueRemove queue thread;
        setQueue tdom prio queue';
        threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbQueued := False \<rparr>) thread;
        when (tcbQueueEmpty queue') $ removeFromBitmap tdom prio
    od)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs timerTick_def:
"timerTick\<equiv> (do
  thread \<leftarrow> getCurThread;
  state \<leftarrow> getThreadState thread;
  (case state of
      Running \<Rightarrow>   (do
      ts \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbTimeSlice thread;
      ts' \<leftarrow> return ( ts - 1);
      if (ts' > 0)
        then threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbTimeSlice := ts' \<rparr>) thread
        else (do
          threadSet (\<lambda> t. t \<lparr> tcbTimeSlice := timeSlice \<rparr>) thread;
          tcbSchedAppend thread;
          rescheduleRequired
        od)
      od)
    | _ \<Rightarrow>   return ()
    );
  when (numDomains > 1) $ (do
      decDomainTime;
      domainTime \<leftarrow> getDomainTime;
      when (domainTime = 0) $ rescheduleRequired
  od)
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
"initTCB\<equiv> (makeObject::tcb)\<lparr> tcbPriority:=maxBound \<rparr>"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>primrec
transferCapsToSlots :: "(machine_word) option \<Rightarrow> machine_word \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> (capability * machine_word) list \<Rightarrow> machine_word list \<Rightarrow> message_info \<Rightarrow> message_info kernel"
where
  "transferCapsToSlots arg1 arg2 n [] arg5 mi = (
    return $ mi \<lparr> msgExtraCaps := fromIntegral n \<rparr>)"
| "transferCapsToSlots ep rcvBuffer n (capWithSrcSlot#caps) slots mi = (
    let
       transferAgain = transferCapsToSlots ep rcvBuffer (n + 1) caps;
       miCapUnfolded = mi \<lparr> msgCapsUnwrapped := msgCapsUnwrapped mi || bit n\<rparr>;
       (cap, srcSlot) = capWithSrcSlot
    in
    constOnFailure (mi \<lparr> msgExtraCaps := fromIntegral n \<rparr>) $ (
        (let (v18, v19, v20) = (cap, ep, slots) in
            if isEndpointCap v18 \<and> v19 \<noteq> None \<and> capEPPtr v18 = the v19
            then let p1 = capEPPtr v18; p2 = p1
            in  (doE
                withoutFailure $
                    setExtraBadge rcvBuffer (capEPBadge cap) n;
                withoutFailure $ transferAgain slots miCapUnfolded
            odE)
            else (case v20 of
            destSlot # slots' \<Rightarrow>  (doE
                cap' \<leftarrow> unifyFailure $ deriveCap srcSlot $ cap;
                whenE (isNullCap cap') $ throw undefined;
                withoutFailure $ cteInsert cap' srcSlot destSlot;
                withoutFailure $ transferAgain slots' mi
            odE)
            | _ \<Rightarrow>  returnOk $ mi \<lparr> msgExtraCaps := fromIntegral n \<rparr>
            )
            )
    ))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs doIPCTransfer_def:
"doIPCTransfer sender endpoint badge grant receiver\<equiv> (do
        receiveBuffer \<leftarrow> lookupIPCBuffer True receiver;
        fault \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbFault sender;
        (case fault of
              None \<Rightarrow>   (do
                sendBuffer \<leftarrow> lookupIPCBuffer False sender;
                doNormalTransfer
                    sender sendBuffer endpoint badge grant
                    receiver receiveBuffer
              od)
            | Some v21 \<Rightarrow>   (
                doFaultTransfer badge sender receiver receiveBuffer
            )
            )
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs doReplyTransfer_def:
"doReplyTransfer sender receiver slot grant\<equiv> (do
    state \<leftarrow> getThreadState receiver;
    haskell_assert (isReply state)
        [];
    mdbNode \<leftarrow> liftM cteMDBNode $ getCTE slot;
    haskell_assert (mdbPrev mdbNode \<noteq> nullPointer
                \<and> mdbNext mdbNode = nullPointer)
        [];
    parentCap \<leftarrow> getSlotCap (mdbPrev mdbNode);
    haskell_assert (isReplyCap parentCap \<and> capReplyMaster parentCap)
        [];
    fault \<leftarrow> threadGet tcbFault receiver;
    (case fault of
          None \<Rightarrow>   (do
            doIPCTransfer sender Nothing 0 grant receiver;
            cteDeleteOne slot;
            setThreadState Running receiver;
            possibleSwitchTo receiver
          od)
        | Some f \<Rightarrow>   (do
            cteDeleteOne slot;
            tag \<leftarrow> getMessageInfo sender;
            sendBuffer \<leftarrow> lookupIPCBuffer False sender;
            mrs \<leftarrow> getMRs sender sendBuffer tag;
            restart \<leftarrow> handleFaultReply f receiver (msgLabel tag) mrs;
            threadSet (\<lambda> tcb. tcb \<lparr>tcbFault := Nothing\<rparr>) receiver;
            if restart
              then (do
                setThreadState Restart receiver;
                possibleSwitchTo receiver
              od)
              else setThreadState Inactive receiver
        od)
        )
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs doNormalTransfer_def:
"doNormalTransfer sender sendBuffer endpoint badge canGrant receiver receiveBuffer\<equiv> (do
        tag \<leftarrow> getMessageInfo sender;
        caps \<leftarrow> if canGrant
            then lookupExtraCaps sender sendBuffer tag
                `~catchFailure~` const (return [])
            else return [];
        msgTransferred \<leftarrow> copyMRs sender sendBuffer receiver receiveBuffer $
                                  msgLength tag;
        tag' \<leftarrow> transferCaps tag caps endpoint receiver receiveBuffer;
        tag'' \<leftarrow> return ( tag' \<lparr> msgLength := msgTransferred \<rparr>);
        setMessageInfo receiver tag'';
        asUser receiver $ setRegister badgeRegister badge
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs transferCaps_def:
"transferCaps info caps endpoint receiver receiveBuffer\<equiv> (do
    destSlots \<leftarrow> getReceiveSlots receiver receiveBuffer;
    info' \<leftarrow> return ( info \<lparr> msgExtraCaps := 0, msgCapsUnwrapped := 0 \<rparr>);
    (case receiveBuffer of
          None \<Rightarrow>   return info'
        | Some rcvBuffer \<Rightarrow>   (
            transferCapsToSlots endpoint rcvBuffer 0
                caps destSlots info'
        )
        )
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
